name: The DelMar Sauna
description:
A much appreciated feature of the DelMar Sauna is the dimensions, somewhat bigger than the Malibu sauna. It provides more space to relax in while you lean back and enjoy your sauna session. The DelMar is a perfect sauna for you !

Let the Delmar Sauna carry you away in an oasis of soft heat provided by the carbon wave 360 heaters. Improve you health and obtain the benefit from the Chromo Therapy lighting inside the sauna. With its beautiful natural design, the Delmar will surely please you. Listen to a relaxing natural SPA music CD and let yourself go. It will feel like heaven. The DelMar is sure to be your favourite retreat !
